entries.title: Coal Echoes  |  Narrative Exploration Game
entries.meta: 2026  ·  In development  ·  Unity 6, HDRP, C#, Blender
bullets: Developing a first person exploration game inspired by family memories of Shitanjing, Ningxia, using photography, a grandfather’s diary, and scrapbooking to tell a story about an abandoned coal plant.
Built photography, album, scrapbook layout, object inspection, and echo discovery systems, with local storage for photographs, layouts, diary progress, and discovered echoes.
Integrated DEM terrain, industrial buildings, and a moving cableway, and developed sandstorm, heat haze, and newspaper photo transition effects to support the setting.

entries.title: Project Fireflies  |  Interactive Light Installation
bullets: Mapped movement and ambient light inputs to firefly disturbance and synchronization behavior using LD2410B radar, light sensors, and WS2812B LEDs.
Configured firmware for 420 LEDs across three swarms, with two independently responsive zones, one ambient swarm, and a UDP interface for Unity synchronization commands.

entries.title: Seafloor Revival  |  GMTK Game Jam 2025
entries.meta: July to August 2025  ·  UI Development and Art Integration  ·  Unity, C#
bullets: Built all game UI in a team of six credited creators, wired component references and related C# behavior, and processed and integrated interface art assets.
Contributed to a 2.5D underwater base building game about recurring pollution disasters, released as a playable browser prototype.

entries.title: Mask  |  Global Game Jam 2026
entries.meta: 2026  ·  Team Game Jam Entry  ·  Unity, C#
bullets: Participated in a 2D narrative platformer about identity and social roles. The project combines household tasks, branching phone conversations during a subway commute, and memories of different identities.

entries.title: Online Computer Graphics Project  |  Mooncake
entries.meta: February to April 2025  ·  Course led by Prof. Saty Raghavachary  ·  Three.js, JavaScript
bullets: Studied 3D modeling, rendering, animation, and GUI interaction; developed the particle system and web demonstration with controls for particle count and size.
Implemented interactive controls with Three.js and lil GUI and documented the graphics implementation and technical approach in a project report.

entries.title: Human Computer Interaction in Indie Games  |  Published Paper
entries.meta: Research November 2022 to June 2023  ·  Published 2023  ·  Sole Author
bullets: Analyzed FAR Lone Sails through its official artbook and gameplay, examining implicit guidance, environmental storytelling, mood building, and emotional attachment to a vehicle.
Published in Lecture Notes in Education Psychology and Public Media, volume 18, pages 194 to 199.

entries.title: IQVIA  |  Technology Solutions Intern
bullets: Created and maintained over 100 pages of user documentation for a pharmaceutical company's WeChat Mini Program platform upgrade, covering two user types, four scenarios, and three device contexts.
Performed user acceptance testing, reported over 10 defects through Jira, and explained reproduction steps and cross platform scenarios in project meetings.
Organized over 1,000 data tags into a three level hierarchy tied to business scenarios to support user filtering and tag prioritization.

entries.title: Coal Echoes 煤火回声  |  叙事探索游戏
bullets: 围绕宁夏石炭井的家庭记忆与工业遗址，设计第一人称探索体验，以摄影、祖父日记和手账串联叙事。
搭建拍照、相册、手账排版、物品检视与回响识别系统，接入照片、手账、日记及回响数据的本地存储。
整合 DEM 地形、厂区与索道场景，制作沙尘、热浪及报纸照片转入游戏的开场效果，支持叙事氛围与探索动线。

entries.title: Project Fireflies  |  萤火虫交互装置
bullets: 将人体移动和环境光输入映射为萤火虫灯群的扰动与同步行为，连接 LD2410B 雷达、光照传感器及 WS2812B 灯带。
固件配置三组共 420 颗 LED，其中两组独立响应传感器，一组维持自然闪烁，并提供 Unity 通过 UDP 控制同步的接口。

entries.title: Seafloor Revival  |  GMTK Game Jam 2025
entries.meta: 2025 年 7 月至 8 月  ·  UI 开发与美术资源接入  ·  Unity、C#
bullets: 在六人署名团队中负责全部游戏 UI 构建、组件引用连接和相关 C# 实现，处理并接入界面美术资源。
作品为以循环污染灾难为主题的 2.5D 海底基地建造游戏，已发布浏览器试玩原型。

entries.title: Mask  |  Global Game Jam 2026

entries.title: 计算机图形学线上项目  |  Mooncake
entries.meta: 2025 年 2 月至 4 月  ·  Saty Raghavachary 教授指导课程  ·  Three.js、JavaScript
bullets: 学习并实践三维建模、渲染、动画与 GUI 交互，负责粒子系统及网页展示，可实时调整粒子数量和大小。
使用 Three.js 与 lil GUI 实现交互控制，并在项目报告中说明图形实现与技术思路。

entries.title: 独立游戏人机交互研究  |  已发表论文
entries.meta: 2022 年 11 月至 2023 年 6 月开展研究  ·  2023 年发表  ·  独立作者
bullets: 以 FAR Lone Sails 为案例，结合官方艺术设定集与游戏场景分析，研究隐性引导、环境叙事、情绪构建以及玩家与载具之间的情感联系。
论文发表于 Lecture Notes in Education Psychology and Public Media，第 18 卷，第 194 至 199 页。

entries.title: IQVIA 艾昆纬  |  技术部门实习
entries.meta: 2024 年 7 月至 8 月  ·  中国上海
bullets: 参与制药企业微信小程序平台升级，根据需求文档编制并维护超过 100 页操作手册，覆盖两类用户、四种场景和三种终端。
执行用户验收测试，通过 Jira 提交超过 10 项缺陷，并在项目会议中说明复现步骤和跨平台使用场景。
结合业务场景梳理超过 1,000 个数据标签与三层分类结构，为用户筛选和标签优先级设计提供支持。
